title: PR #184: docs(catalog): master architecture registry for X1–X36 and L1–L10
content:
State: open
Merged: False
Draft: True

## Summary

Adds a consolidated master architecture catalog baseline for the X1–X36 cross-cutting layers and L1–L10 system architecture layers.

### Included
- L1–L10 system-layer registry with responsibility boundaries and canonical ownership rules.
- X1–X36 cross-cutting registry and overlap/boundary notes.
- Reusable sublayer decomposition baseline.
- Component and function-contract metadata model.
- Canonical SSOT ownership rules and explicit unknown mappings.
- Separate architecture, mapping, implementation, verification and reconciliation statuses.
- Evidence record, G0–G9 acceptance gates, domain-specific acceptance profiles.
- Evidence-backed reconciliation queue and measurable catalog completeness definition.

### Governance
- Preserves Catalog First / Standalone First / Evidence before Acceptance.
- Does not introduce production implementations or claim function-level source census is complete.
- Marks catalog-wide reconciliation, source mappings, validators, and CI evidence as NOT VERIFIED / BLOCKED until demonstrated.
- Keeps `demo-repository` excluded from the live drift gate.
- Normative requirements remain subject to approved `atc-standards` change control.

### Verification state
Documentation change only. This PR does not assert that all sublayers, components or function contracts have been reconciled or verified. Follow-up work must reconcile existing catalog entries and Issues #112, #136–#145, #146–#181, #182 and #183 without duplicating their work.
